subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should maintainers consolidate this PR with the active Discord-progress and descendant-accounting PRs and adopt `deferred` as a permanent nonterminal public cron status?
rationale: The choice determines both cross-branch ownership and a new persisted/protocol/plugin SDK compatibility contract; code review cannot safely choose that product boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor one consolidated lifecycle PR
options.body: Select one canonical branch, absorb the valid fixes, define `deferred` as nonterminal, and close or rebase overlapping branches after exact-head proof.

options.title: Split by owner boundary
options.body: Land cron lifecycle, descendant accounting, and Discord UI changes separately with explicit APIs and a maintainer-defined landing order.

options.title: Keep deferred internal
options.body: Fix parent lifecycle ownership without adding a new persisted, protocol, CLI, UI, or plugin SDK status.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one consolidated lifecycle PR
recommendation.body: Select one canonical branch, absorb the valid fixes, define `deferred` as nonterminal, and close or rebase overlapping branches after exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main provenance is the recent cross-surface lifecycle refactor touching cron, Discord, and subagent registry ownership.
